title: Official I-012 continued head edits do not falsely rewrite userSavedRevision

surveyedButNotOfficialized.clause: 各崩溃点注入后只开最后好snapshot+tail
surveyedButNotOfficialized.reason: ADR 0003 still records unfinished validated fallback checkpoint+tail reconstruction and missing-revision reports; no RecoveryService or crash_points suite; V-005 / save_crash fifty SIGKILL archive-phase trials are not this clause and were not re-qualified; no tightly bounded already-admitted subset was genuinely new without inventing reconstruction.

clausesNotRequalified: 虚拟时钟验证全部触发
保存完成只在durable receipt之后
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Existing save_test.dart officializes virtual-clock triggers, identical-request coalescing, and “no receipt means the save is not complete”, and the coalesce test asserts that head and the saved artifact do not move backwards after both saves complete. Increment 1.90 asserts userSavedRevision only as support for I-011 durableRevision. No official I-012 suite had closed this remainingAcceptance wording for post-receipt and in-flight continued head edits. Those files were not reused, weakened, or rewritten.
